Its single combined saved-result view replaced separate result reads and handwritten scope checking. The candidate worker incurred a malformed patch and a mistaken Done!-string success check before its sole native submission; its five responses and increased cost remain included. Both callers retained an extra readback of the adapter-written check. One pair does not attribute every response difference to the code.
